title: Add ToolLayout design system component, fix all tool page layouts
body: ## Summary Adds reusable `ToolLayout` and `ToolHeader` components to `src/components/Layout.tsx` so all tool pages share the same layout pattern: tool title as home link, flush-left back button, no global nav/footer, consistent spacing. All three tool pages (Seating Planner, Template Library, Merch Coordinator) are refactored to use ``. The Merch Coordinator (from PR #17) had the same broken layout issue — global Nav and Footer — which is now fixed. **Props:** - `title` — header text + home link - `backTo` / `backLabel` — configurable back link (defaults to `/toolkit`) - `headerRight` — optional right-side content (stats, buttons) - `fullScreen` — `true` for canvas tools, `false` for scrollable pages - `children` — page content **Additional fixes:** widened Merch Coordinator sidebar to 340px, stacked Seating Planner guest inputs vertically. ## Review & Testing Checklist for Human - [ ] Navigate to `/toolkit/seat-arrangement` — verify no global nav, "Seating Planner" title links home, "Back to Toolkit" is flush left - [ ] Navigate to `/toolkit/merch-coordinator` — verify same header pattern (no global nav/footer), "Merch Coordinator" title links home - [ ] Navigate to `/toolkit/templates` — verify same header pattern with footer still present - [ ] Add a guest in Seating Planner — confirm Title/Company inputs are not cut off (stacked vertically) ### Notes Usage for new tool pages: ```tsx import { ToolLayout } from "@/components/Layout"; export default function MyTool() { return ( {/* tool content */} ); } ``` Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/efd68ce354a949eb9971169301675a64 Requested by: @mattbergland ---
